ए: ए The eleventh vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to the letter E as pronounced in most languages except the English, and having the sound of A in amiable.
ए ind. An interjection of, 1. Remembering, (ha.) 	 2. Censure or con-tempt. 	 3. Compassion, (ah!) 	 4. Addressing, (eh! hey.) 	 5. Calling, (hey, ho.)
ए m. (-एः) A name of VISHNŪ.
एक: एक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. One. 	 2. Alone, solitary. 	 3. Other, different. 	 4. Chief, pre-eminent.  E. इण् to go, Unādi affix कन्.
एकऋक्थिन्: एकऋक्थिन् m. (-थी) A coheir.  E. एक one (father,) ऋक्थिन् heir.
एकक: एकक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Alone, solitary.  E. एक one, &c. कन् aff.
एककर: एककर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Making one. 	 2. One-handed. 	 3. One-rayed. E. एक and कर making, &c.
एककार्य: एककार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Performing the same office, answering the same end.  E. एक and कार्य्य act.
एककार्य्य: एककार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Performing the same office, answering the same end.  E. एक and कार्य्य act.
एककाल: एककाल m. (-लः) One or the same time.  E. एक and काल time.
एककालभोजन: एककालभोजन n. (-नं) Eating but one meal in any given time.  E. एककाल and भोजन food.
एककालीन: एककालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Coeval, cotemporary.  E. एक and कालीन relating to time.
एककुण्डल: एककुण्डल m. (-लः) 	 1. A name of BALARĀMA. 	 2. An epithet of KUVERA. E. एक and कुण्डल an ear-ring: wearing it in one ear.
एकक्षीर: एकक्षीर n. (-रं) The milk of one (nurse; &c.)  E. एक and क्षीर milk.
एकगुरु: एकगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual brother, pupil of the same preceptor.  E. एक and गुरु a religious preceptor; also with कन् added एकगुरुक.
एकग्रामीण: एकग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Of the same town or village.  E. एक one, ग्रामीण villager.
एकचक्र: एकचक्र m. (-क्रः) The name of a city: see हरिगृह.  E. एक, चक्र a circle.
एकचर: एकचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Solitary, alone. 	 2. Having one follower. 	 m. (-रः) A rhinoceros.  E. एक alone, and चर who goes.
एकचारिन्: एकचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going alone or with one follower only. 	 m. (-री) A follower of BUDDHA.  E. एक one, चर् to go, णिनि aff.
एकचित्त: एकचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Thinking of one thing only, intent upon, absorbed in. 	 2. Of one mind, agreeing, concurring.  E. एक one, चित्त the mind.
एकजन्मन्: एकजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) 	 1. A king, a sovereign. 	 2. A Sudra.  E. एक best or one, जन्मन् birth.
एकजात: एकजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of one parentage, born of the same parents. E. एक and जात born.
एकजाति: एकजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 	 1. Of the same caste. 	 2. Once born. 	 m. (-तः) A Sudra.  E. एक one, and जाति birth or caste: not being regenerat-ed by investiture, &c.
एकज्या: एकज्या f. (-ज्या) 	 1. The chord of an arc. 	 2. Sine of 30° or of the radius. E. एक and ज्या a cord.
एकतम: एकतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) One of many.  E. एक and डतमच् affix of the superlative.
एकतर: एकतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Either, one of two. 	 2. Other, different.  E. एक and डतरच् affix of the comparative.
एकतस्: एकतस् ind. On one side, on one part.  E. एक and तसिल् aff.
एकता: एकता f. (-ता) Unity, oneness.  E. एक and तल् affix. or with त्व aff. एकत्व n. (-त्वं)
एकतान: एकतान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Closely attentive, having the mind fixed on one only object. 	 m. (-नः) Musical unison: see the next.  E. एक, तन् to stretch or spread, घञ् aff.
एकताल: एकताल m. (-लः) Harmony, unison, the accurate adjustment of song, dance, and instrumental music. 	 f. (-ली) An instrument for heating time, any instrument having but one note.  E. एक one, uniform, and ताल musical measure or time.
एकतीर्थिन्: एकतीर्थिन् m. (-र्थी) A spiritual brother, an associate in religious offices or objects.  E. एक one, the same, तीर्थ place of pilgrimage, इनि aff.
एकत्र: एकत्र ind. Together, in one, in one place.  E. एक and त्रल् aff.
एकदंष्ट्र: एकदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A name of GANESA.  E. एक and दंष्ट्र a tooth, single toothed or tusked; the fellow being broken off in a scuffle by KARTIKEYA, or according to another legend by PARSURAMA; also एकदन्त.
एकदन्त: एकदन्त m. (-न्तः) A name of GANESA: see the preceding.  E. एक and दन्त a tooth.
एकदा: एकदा ind. At the same time, at once.  E. एक and दाच् aff.
एकदुःखसुख: एकदुःखसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Sympathizing, having the same joys and sorrows.  E. एक, and दुःख pain, सुख pleasure.
एकदृश्: एकदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) One-eyed. 	 m. (-दृक्) 	 1. A name of MAHADEVA. 	 2. A crow.  E. एक and दृश् an eye: SIVA is termed one-eyed, from the eye in his forehead.
एकदेश: एकदेश m. (-शः) A part, a portion, a division.  E. एक and देश place.
एकदेह: एकदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Elegatnly formed. 	 2. Single bodied. 	 m. (-हः) The planet MERCURY.  E. एक best or one, and देह body.
एकधा: एकधा ind. In one way.  E. एक and धाच् aff.
एकधुर्: एकधुर् f. (-धूः) A particular burthen or conveyance.  E. एक and धुर् a load.
एकधुर: एकधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cattle for special burthen, fit for but one kind of labour. E. See एकधुरीण.
एकधुरावह: एकधुरावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) See the preceding.  E. एक, धुर burthen, and आवह who bears.
एकधुरीण: एकधुरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Cattle of special burthen.  E. एक, धुर a burthen, ख affix which leaves ईण, or with अ affix forming एकधुर.
एकनट: एकनट m. (-टः) The principal actor in a drama, the manager.  E. एक chief, and नट an actor.
एकनाथ: एकनाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Having one master. 	 m. (-थः) Sole master or lord. E. एक and नाथ lord.
एकपक्ष: एकपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) An associate, a firm ally or partizan.  E. एक one, पक्ष part: of the same side or party.
एकपत्नी: एकपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 	 1. A faithful wife, one devoted to her husband. 	 2. The wife of a man who has no other wives.  E. एक one or excellent, पति a husband, न substituted for the final, and ङीप् aff.
एकपत्रिका: एकपत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, white basil,  E. एक end, पत्र a leaf.
एकपद: एकपद adv. 	 n. (-दं) Then, at that time, at once. 	 m. (-दः) A single inflec-tion of a verb or noun. 	 f. (-दी) A road, a path or way.  E. एक one, पद a foot, fem. affix ङीप्.
एकपरि: एकपरि ind. One over, a term at dice.  E. एक and परि over, against.
एकपात: एकपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sudden, rapid, coming suddenly or at once. E. एक and पात falling upon.
एकपाद्: एकपाद् m. (-त्) A name of SIVA.  E. एक best, and पाद् a ray.
एकपिङ्ग: एकपिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of KUVERA.  E. एक one, and पिङ्ग tawny: hav-ing a yellow mark in the place of one of his eyes.
एकपिङ्गल: एकपिङ्गल m. (-लः) See the preceding. E. As before.
एकपिण्ड: एकपिण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Related, near of kin, united by the offering of the funeral cake.  E. एक and पिण्ड a funeral cake.
एकपिण्डता: एकपिण्डता f. (-ता) Connexion by the funeral cake, consanguinity.  E. एक-पिण्ड and तल् affix; also with त्व, एकपिण्डत्वं.
एकफल: एकफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having one or a principal result or object. E. एक and फल fruit.
एकभक्त: एकभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Attached to a common master. 	 2. Wor-shipping one deity. 	 3. Eating together. 	 4. Eating but one meal, (a day.)  E. एक and भक्त attached to, or भक्त food.
एकभक्तव्रत: एकभक्तव्रत n. (-तं) Eating but once a day as a religious obligation.  E. एक, भक्त food, व्रत vow.
एकभक्ति: एकभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) 	 1. Of one faith. 	 2. Believing in one deity. E. एक and भक्ति faith.
एकभाव: एकभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of a simple or single nature or temperament. E. एक and भाव disposition.
एकभुक्त: एकभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Eating but one meal, (a day, &c.) 	 2. Eating together.  E. एक and भुक्त eaten.
एकभोजन: एकभोजन n. (-नं) 	 1. Eating in common, feeding together. 	 2. Eating one meal a day, &c.  E. एक and भोजन food.
एकमुख: एकमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) 	 1. Having one chief or head. 	 2. Onefaced. E. एक and मुख the mouth.
एकमूला: एकमूला f. (-ला) 	 1. A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) 	 2. Flax, (Linum.) E. एक and मूल root.
एकयष्टिका: एकयष्टिका f. (-का) A single string of flowers, pearls, &c.  E. एक and यष्टिका a necklace, &c.
एकयोनि: एकयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Uterine, of the same mother.  E. एक and योनि womb.
एकरज: एकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Verbesina scandens:) see भृङ्गराज.  E. एक excel-lent, and रजस् farina.
एकरस: एकरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Of one flavour.  E. एक and रस flavour.
एकरात्र: एकरात्र n. (-त्रं) One night, a night.  E. एक and रात्रि night.
एकरात्रिक: एकरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) For a night, of a night.  E. एक and रात्रि night, with ठक् aff.
एकराशि: एकराशि f. (-शिः) A heap, a crowd.  E. एक and राशि a heap.
एकराशिभूत: एकराशिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped or collected together.  E. एकराशि and भूत become.
एकल: एकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Alone, solitary; a various reading of एकक.
एकलिङ्ग: एकलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of KUVERA. 	 2. A place or district in which for five Cos there is but one Phallus.  E. एक one or best, लिङ्ग a mark, &c.
एकवद्भाव: एकवद्भाव m. (-वः) An aggregate of many, as in grammar, the formation of a compound noun of several nouns.  E. एक, वत् like, भाव property.
एकवर्ण: एकवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Of one caste or tribe. 	 2. Of one colour. 	 3. Of one quality. 	 m. (-र्णः) One unknown quantity, (in algebra.) 	 f. (-र्णी) Beating time, marking musical measure by clapping the hands, or the instrument which does so, a castanet: see एकताली. E. एक, वर्ण a quality, a note, and ङीष् aff.
एकवर्णसमीकरण: एकवर्णसमीकरण n. (-णं) Uniliteral equation.  E. एकवर्ण and समीकरण equation.
एकवर्षिका: एकवर्षिका f. (-का) A heifer one year old.  E. एक, वर्ष a year, ठक् aff.
एकवाद: एकवाद m. (-दः) A musical instrument, a kind of drum or tabor.  E. एक principal, वाद sound: high-sounding.
एकवीर: एकवीर m. (-रः) A chief warrior.  E. एक and वीर a hero.
एकवृक्ष: एकवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A desert-place, in which but one tree is seen for four Cos.  E. एक and वृक्ष a tree.
एकवेणी: एकवेणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A single braid of hair. 	 2. A woman whose hair is tied in one braid.  E. एक and वेणी a tress.
एकशफ: एकशफ m. (-फः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. Any animal whose hoof is not cloven. E. एक one, uniform, and शफ a hoof.
एकशरण: एकशरण n. (-णं) One only hope or refuge, especially applied to a deity. E. एक and शरण protection.
एकशरीर: एकशरीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Consanguineous, of one body or blood. 	 2. Of one or the same body.  E. एक, शरीर body.
एकशरीरान्वय: एकशरीरान्वय m. (-यः) Consanguineous descent.  E. एकशरीर and अन्वय lineage.
एकशरीरारम्भ: एकशरीरारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Commencement of consanguinity by the union of father and mother.  E. एकशरीर and आरम्भ beginning.
एकशरीरावयव: एकशरीरावयव m. (-वः) A descendant in a right line, a kinsman by blood. E. एकशरीर and अवयव a member.
एकशरीरावयवत्व: एकशरीरावयवत्व n. (-त्वं) Consanguineous descent or connexion.  E. त्व added to the last.
एकशाख: एकशाख m. (-खः) A Brahman of the same branch or school.  E. एक and शाखा a branch, (of the Vedas.)
एकशृङ्ग: एकशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A title of VISHNU or KRISHNA. 	 2. A unicorn, a rhinoceros, &c.  E. एक and शृङ्ग a mark or horn.
एकसर्ग: एकसर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Closely attentive, having the mind intent upon one object.  E. एक one, and सृज् to create, घञ् aff.
एकसूत्र: एकसूत्र m. (-त्रः) A small double drum, played by a string and ball at-tached to the body of it: see वृषाङ्कज.  E. एक and सूत्र a thread.
एकसूनु: एकसूनु m. (-नुः) An only son.  E. एक, and सूनु a son.
एकस्थ: एकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Collected, assembled, conjoined, in one site or place.  E. एक and स्थ what stays.
एकस्थान: एकस्थान n. (-नं) One place, the same place.  E. एक and स्थान place.
एकहायनी: एकहायनी f. (-नी) A heifer one year old.  E. एक, हायन a year, affix ङीष्.
एकाकिन्: एकाकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Alone, solitary.  E. एक and आकिनिच् aff.
एकाक्ष: एकाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) One-eyed. 	 m. (-क्षः) A crow.  E. एक and अक्षि an eye.
एकाक्षर: एकाक्षर n. (-रं) A monosyllable, especially the sacred monosyllable Om. E. एक and अक्षर a letter.
एकाग्र: एकाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 	 1. Intent, closely attentive, fixed on one object. 2. Undisturbed, unperplexed. 	 3. Known, celebrated. 	 4. Single-pointed. 	 m. (-ग्रः) The whole of a long line which is subdivided. E. एक and अग्र chief, &c.
एकाग्रता: एकाग्रता f. (-ता) Close and undisturbed attention.  E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, एकाग्रत्वं.
एकाग्र्य: एकाग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Closely attentive: see the preceding. E. एक, अग्र्य chief, &c.
एकाङ्ग: एकाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MERCURY. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) Sandal.  E. एक best, pre-eminent, and अङ्ग body.
एकादश: एकादश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Eleven, eleventh. 	 f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the half month: it is especially sacred to VISHNU and fasting on it is most efficacious.  E. एकादशन् eleven, affix ड.
एकादशन्: एकादशन् plur. 	 mfn. (-श) Eleven.  E. एक one, दशन् ten, with आङ् inserted.
एकानंशा: एकानंशा f. (-शा) A name of PĀRVATĪ.  E. अंश a part, with the neg. pref. and एक pre-eminent: chief and undivided.
एकानुदिष्ट: एकानुदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Left, as a funeral feast, one who has recent-ly partaken of it.  E. एक one, (ancestor,) अनु after, दिष्ट shown.
एकान्त: एकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Excessive. 	 2. Solitary, lonely, retired. 	 3. Aside, apart. adv. 	 n. (-न्तं) 	 1. Much, excessive. 	 2. Apart.  E. एक one and अन्त end.
एकान्तकरुण: एकान्तकरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Very compassionate, weakly charitable. E. एकान्त and करुण charitable.
एकान्ततस्: एकान्ततस् ind. 	 1. Alone, apart, privately. 	 2. Much, exceedingly. E. एकान्त and तसिल् aff.
एकान्तर: एकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Next but one.  E. एक and अन्तर between.
एकान्तस्थित: एकान्तस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Staying alone or apart.  E. एकान्त and स्थित staying.
एकाब्दा: एकाब्दा f. (-ब्दा) A heifer one year old.  E. एक and अब्द a year.
एकायन: एकायन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Closely attentive, intent.  E. एक, अयन going.
एकायनगत: एकायनगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) See the preceding.  E. एकायन and गत being, having gone.
एकावली: एकावली f. (-ली) A single string of beads, flowers, &c.  E. एक and आवली a row.
एकार्थ: एकार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Having one sense or meaning. 	 2. Having one or the same object.  E. एक and अर्थ meaning.
एकाश्रितगुण: एकाश्रितगुण m. (-णः) A simple attribute or predicate, as form, taste, smell, &c.  E. एक one, आश्रित invested, गुण property.
एकाष्टी: एकाष्टी f. (-ष्टी) A pod or seed of cotton.
एकाष्टील: एकाष्टील m. (-लः) A plant: see वकपुष्प; the flowers are sacred to SIVA. f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)  E. एक best, अष्टि seed, and ल what gives or takes, from ला with क aff.
एकाह: एकाह n. (-हं) The period of one day.  E. एक and अहन् a day.
एकाहगम: एकाहगम m. (-मः) A day's journey.  E. एकाह and गम going.
एकीभाव: एकीभाव m. (-वः) Common nature or property.  E. एक with च्वि augment, and भाव nature.
एकीय: एकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A companion, a partizan or associate.  E. एक one, and छण् affix. also एकपक्ष.
एकैक: एकैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Single, one by one  E. एक repeated.
एकैकशस्: एकैकशस् ind. One by one, severally, seriatim.  E. एक repeated, with शसि aff.
एकोद्दिष्ट: एकोद्दिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) The Sraddha or funeral rite offered to one person only.  E. एक and उद्दिष्ट addressed to.
एकोशिका: एकोशिका f. (-का) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra:) see एकाष्टील.
एकौघभूत: एकौघभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, crowded together.  E. एक one, ओघ quantity, भूत become.
एज: एज r. 1st cl. (ऋ) (एजृ) (एजते) To shine. (एजति) To shake or tremble.
एजन: एजन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling.  E. एज् and ल्युट् aff.
एजयत्: एजयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to shake or tremble.  E. एज् to shake, causal form, शतृ aff.
एजित: एजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling.  E. एज् to shake, क्त aff.
एजितव्य: एजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be shaken.  E. एज and तव्य aff.
एजितृ: एजितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Shaking, trembling.  E. एज् and तृच् aff.
एठ: एठ r. 1st cl. (एठते) To annoy, to resist or oppose.
एड: एड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Deaf.  E. ईड् to praise, आङ् prefixed, अच् or घञ् aff.
एडक: एडक m. (-कः) 	 1. A ram. 	 2. A wild goat. 	 f. (-का) A ewe.  E. ईल् to go, ण्वुल् affix; and ल changed to ड.
एडगज: एडगज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant, used for the cure of ring-worms, (Cassia tora.)  E. एड a sheep, गज to sound, अच् aff.
एडमूक: एडमूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Deaf and dumb. 	 2. Wicked, perverse.  E. एड deaf, and मूक dumb.
एडुक: एडुक n. (-कं) 	 1. A building constructed of rubbish, bones, &c. 	 2. A wall enclosing bones, a tomb, &c. 	 3. A building of hard subs-tances resembling bones.  E. ईड to throw or send, deriv. irr.; also एडूक and एडोक.
एण: एण mf. (-णः-णी) A kind of deer or antelope, described as being of a black colour, with beautiful eyes, and short legs.  E. इण् to go, ण aff.
एणक: एणक m. (-कः) A species of deer or antelope: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to एण.
एणतिलक: एणतिलक m. (-कः) The moon.  E. एण an antelope, and तिलक the secta-rial mark; a deer being fancifully visible in the moon.
एणभृत्: एणभृत् m. (-त्) The moon.  E. एण and भृत् who nourishes: see the preceding.
एणाजिन: एणाजिन n. (-नं) A deer-skin.  E. एण and अजिन the same.
एत: एत mfn. (-तः-ता or -ती-तं) Of a variegated colour. (-तः-ता-तं) Arrived, come. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A deer or antelope. 	 2. A variegated colour.  E. इण् to go, तन् affix; when signifying colour, the fem. affix is either टाप् or ङीप्, and before the latter, त is changed to न.
एतद्: एतद् pron. 	 mfn. (एषः एषा एतद् or एतत्) This.  E. एत derived from इण् to go, and तद् Unādi aff.
एतन: एतन m. (-नः) Expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the lungs.  E. इण् to go, तनन् aff.
एतर्हि: एतर्हि ind. Now, at this time.  E. एत substituted for इदम्. and र्हिल् aff.
एतश: एतश m. (-शः) A Brahman.  E. इण् to go, and तश Unādi aff.
एतशस्: एतशस् m. (-शाः) A Brahman or man of the first class.  E. इण् to go, तशस् aff.
एतादृश्: एतादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, such like.  E. एतद् this. दृश् to see, क्विप् aff.
एतादृश: एतादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, such like.  E. एतद् this, दृश् to see, कञ् aff.
एतावत्: एतावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) So many, so much, so far. ind. (-वत्) So far, thus far, so much, &c.  E. एतद्, and मतुप् or वति aff.
एत्थ: एत्थ ind. Having gone to or approached.  E. इण् to go, ल्यप् aff.
एध: एध r. 1st cl. (एधते) To grow or increase.
एध m. (-धः) Fuel, as wood, grass, &c.  E. एध् to increase, घञ् aff.
एधतु: एधतु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Increased, grown. 	 m. (-तुः) 	 1. Man. 	 2. Fire.  E. एध् to increase, तु Unādi aff.
एधनीय: एधनीय mfn. (-तः-या-यं) To be enlarged or increased.  E. एध् to grow, and अनीयर् affix; also एधितव्य and एध्य.
एधस्: एधस् n. (-धः) Fuel: see एध.  E. एध् to grow, Unādi affix असुन्.
एधित: एधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, grown.  E. एध् to increase, affix क्त.
एधितृ: एधितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Increasing, growing, enlarging.  E. एध् to grow, and तृच् aff.
एनस्: एनस् n. (एनः) 	 1. Sin, fault, offence. 	 2. Censure, blame.  E. इण् to go, असुन् Unādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
एनस्विन्: एनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Sinful, a sinner.  E. एनस् and विनि aff.
एरका: एरका f. (-का) A sort of grass of emollient and diluent properties.
एरङ्ग: एरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of fish; also एलङ्ग.
एरण्ड: एरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor-oil plant, (Palma christi or Ricinus com-munis. ) 	 f. (-ण्डी) Long pepper.  E. इर् to go, &c. आङ् prefixed, अण्डच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added एरण्डक.
एरण्डक: एरण्डक m. (-कः) Palma christi: see the preceding.
एरण्डपत्रिका: एरण्डपत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Danti.  E. एरण्ड, and पत्र leaf, having similar leaves.
एरण्डफला: एरण्डफला f. (-ला) A plant: see the preceding.  E. एरण्ड, and फल fruit.
एर्वारु: एर्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) E. See ईर्व्वारु.
एलक: एलक m. (-कः) A ram: see एडक.  E. ड and ल being interchanged.
एलङ्ग: एलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus marginatus, BUCH.) Also एरङ्ग.
एलवालु: एलवालु n. (-लु) The name of a perfume: see the next word.
एलवालुक: एलवालुक n. (-कं) A granular substance apparently vegetable, of a red-dish brown colour, and used as a drug and as a perfume.  E. एला cardamoms, वल् to breathe, उण् affix, and कन् added, or without कन्, एलवालु.
एलविल: एलविल m. (-लः) A name of KUVERA: see ऐलविल.
एला: एला f. (-ला) Cardamoms, the seed of the Eletteria cardamomum, or Alpinia Cardamomum: it applies to both the large and small cardamom, but most commonly to the former.  E. इल् to send, &c. अच् aff.
एलापत्र: एलापत्र m. (-त्रः) One of the chiefs of the Nagas or serpent-race.
एलापर्णी: एलापर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)  E. एला cardamoms, and पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् fem. aff.
एलीका: एलीका f. (-का) Small cardamoms.  E. एला, and ईकन् added.
एव: एव mfn. (एवः एवा एवं) Going, moving. ind. As, like, &c.: see एवम्.  E. इण् to go, Unadi affix वन्: see the next.
एवम्: एवम् ind. A particle implying, 1. Likeness, (as, so, like.) 	 2. Assent, (yes, verily.) 	 3. Sameness of manner, (thus, in this way.) 	 4. Certainly, (indeed, assuredly, even so.) 	 5. Command, (so, thus, &c.) 	 6. An expletive.  E. इण् to go, वम् affix; also एव.
एवम्भूत: एवम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) So such, in such manner.  E. एवम्, and भूत been.
एवम्विध: एवम्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Such, in such form or manner, of such a kind E. एवम्, and विध sort, way.
एष: एष r. 1st. cl. (ऋ) एषृ (एषते) To go or approach.
एषण: एषण m. (-णः) An iron arrow. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A goldsmith's balance, assay scales. 	 2. An iron or steel probe.  E. एष् to go, ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.
एषणिका: एषणिका f. (-का) A goldsmith's balance. E. As before, with कन् and टाप् added.
एषणीय: एषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be desired, desirable. 	 2. To be aimed at. E. इष् to wish, affix अनीयर्.
एषा: एषा f. (-षा) Desire.  E. इष् to wish, अङ् and टाप् aff.
एषितृ: एषितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wishing, desirous.  E. इष् to wish, तृच् aff.
एष्टृ: एष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Wishing, desirous.  E. इष् to wish, तृच् aff.
